brief.title: Gold Price Dynamics: A Comprehensive Trend and Volatility Analysis (2000–2025)
brief.one_liner: An in-depth analysis of gold price behavior over two decades, covering price trends, volatility regimes, seasonal patterns, and momentum dynamics.
brief.goal: Equip financial analysts with a thorough understanding of gold's historical price structure, volatility clustering, seasonal tendencies, and liquidity patterns to inform macro-asset allocation and risk management decisions.

required_sections.title: Market Overview & Long-Term Price Trend
required_sections.objective: Summarize the overall trajectory of gold prices from 2000 to the present, highlighting major bull and bear phases, all-time highs, and key inflection points.

required_sections.title: Volatility Analysis & Regime Detection
required_sections.objective: Analyze rolling volatility measures (e.g., rolling standard deviation of returns), identify periods of volatility clustering, and characterize distinct market regimes (low-vol, high-vol, crisis).

required_sections.title: Seasonal & Calendar-Based Patterns
required_sections.objective: Examine whether gold exhibits recurring monthly or day-of-week patterns in returns and volume, and quantify the strength of any seasonal effects.

required_sections.title: Return Distribution & Tail Risk
required_sections.objective: Profile the statistical distribution of daily returns including skewness, kurtosis, and tail behavior to assess the risk characteristics of gold as an asset.

required_sections.title: Momentum Dynamics & Liquidity Behavior
required_sections.objective: Evaluate short- and medium-term momentum signals (e.g., moving average crossovers, rate of change) and analyze how trading volume relates to price movements and trend strength.

required_sections.title: Key Takeaways & Forward-Looking Considerations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable insights for portfolio construction and risk management, noting current regime context and potential scenarios.

kpis.name: Annualized Return
kpis.description: Compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of gold's closing price over the full dataset period.

kpis.name: Annualized Volatility
kpis.description: Standard deviation of daily log returns, annualized (×√252), as a measure of overall risk.

kpis.name: Maximum Drawdown
kpis.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline in closing price, indicating worst-case loss scenario.

kpis.name: Average Daily Volume
kpis.description: Mean daily trading volume across the dataset, serving as a baseline liquidity indicator.

kpis.name: Sharpe-Like Ratio
kpis.description: Annualized return divided by annualized volatility (assuming zero risk-free rate) as a simple risk-adjusted performance metric.
